verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say Pods are billed by the second for compute and storage, and that all compute and storage charges on the account are billed per second. Serverless is billed only from when a worker starts until it fully stops, rounded up to the nearest second, and Flex workers scale to zero when idle. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that stopped Pods stop accruing compute charges (storage is billed per second separately, so it may continue while a Pod is stopped), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the billing behavior.
